finding_dispositions.problem: Publication here is internal gradient-result publication, not posting user content publicly. प्रकाशित can misleadingly suggest map/asset publishing.
finding_dispositions.decision: Edited as independently requested; awaiting original reviewer recheck
finding_dispositions.after: उपयोग में लाने से पहले GPU के परिणामों की स्केलर CPU के परिणामों से तुलना करें। इससे गणना बढ़ती है और अंतर मिलने पर खेल रुक जाता है।

editor_notes: Internal publication means making computedfields available, not publicasset publishing; explicitly compare GPUresults with CPUresults, not deviceitself.
Playbackposition describes location within music rather than the running/paused state.
Exact codec/FFmpeg/MCP/GPU/CPU names and source numerical defaults preserved; no execution or access semantics changed.
certification: Agent edited; not native-human-certified; rendering/platform gates separate
